Step One InBody Body Composition

Know your body.
Actually.

The scale only tells part of the story. The InBody scan gives you the full picture — breaking down your body into muscle mass, fat mass, water and bone, with precise measurements by body segment. It's the starting point for every body composition programme we run.

In under two minutes, you'll know exactly where you stand — and our team will show you exactly what it means and what to do about it.

InBody scanning uses bioelectrical impedance analysis to map your body composition with medical-grade accuracy — the same technology used in hospitals and elite sports science facilities worldwide. It's the same scanner our competitive athletes use to track training progress at Maddog Performance Institute.

  • Full body fat percentage and fat mass in kg
  • Skeletal muscle mass by individual limb
  • Visceral fat rating (the dangerous fat around organs)
  • Total body water and hydration status
  • Basal metabolic rate calculation
  • Body composition history tracking over time

Medical Supervision Slimming Clinic

Weight loss that lasts.

Our slimming clinic is not a diet programme — it's a medically supervised body transformation protocol. Every client begins with a doctor assessment. Your programme is prescribed by Dr. Du Plessis, monitored by our clinical team and adjusted as you progress.

We address the full picture: hormonal imbalance, metabolic dysfunction, nutritional deficiency, lifestyle factors and body composition — not just the number on the scale.

  • Full medical assessment before any protocol begins
  • Individualised weight management plan

Peptide Therapy

Prescribed.
Monitored.
Precise.

Peptide therapy represents the frontier of evidence-based wellness — small chains of amino acids that act as biological messengers, directing your body to repair, regenerate and optimise in ways that other treatments cannot achieve.

At Maddog Performance Health & Wellness, all peptide protocols are individually prescribed by Dr. Du Plessis following a full clinical assessment. We do not offer off-the-shelf peptide products. Every protocol is designed for you specifically, sourced from SAPHRA-approved compounding pharmacies and monitored throughout.

"Peptides work with your body's own systems — not against them. When correctly prescribed and monitored, they offer profound support for fat loss, muscle preservation, recovery, sleep, hormonal balance and cellular regeneration."
